items.title: Unauthenticated Server-Side Request Forgery in Rootways Authorize.net CIM Pro extension
items.summary: This vulnerability in the Rootways Authorize.net CIM Pro extension for Magento 2 allows unauthenticated attackers to read sensitive files like app/etc/env.php credentials and encryption keys via SSRF in the Apple Pay merchant validation controller. It carries a CVSS base score of 9.3.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including five critical ones, that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. The most severe, CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), is an unauthenticated template engine injection with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Template Engine Injection (BlockStrap)
items.summary: Part of APSB26-153, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code through a template engine injection. Adobe is not aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-153, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could allow unauthenticated code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This emergency out-of-band security update resolves CVE-2026-75650, a critical vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this zero-day being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: Discovered by Sansec and named StyleSmuggler, this zero-day RCE (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to execute remote code. Adobe released an emergency hotfix as APSB26-146 due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and several incorrect authorization issues. Successful exploitation could lead to privilege escalation and security feature bypass.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-138, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts into the database, leading to privilege escalation when an admin views the affected area.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: Another critical stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) from APSB26-138, exploitable without authentication, that can result in privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, five of which are rated Critical, including CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: Addressed in APSB26-92, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to the victim's account and private data without authentication.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin resolves 13 vulnerabilities, including eight critical ones, with impacts such as arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. It includes an unauthenticated file-upload flaw scoring CVSS 9.6.

items.title: Unauthenticated Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: Part of APSB26-73, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability from APSB26-73 that affects standard Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source stores, allowing malicious code to be saved and executed.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in B2B
items.summary: This critical stored XSS vulnerability, specific to Adobe Commerce B2B and addressed in APSB26-73, allows malicious code injection that persists and executes when affected pages are loaded.
